description.value: A five-storey heritage boutique hotel situated in the heart of downtown Nanaimo, directly overlooking Nanaimo Harbour with 71 non-smoking rooms and suites. Its central location places touring cyclists within easy reach of the Departure Bay and Duke Point BC Ferries terminals and the downtown waterfront. The hotel offers complimentary parking and free guest laundry, making it a practical overnight stop on a multi-day coastal tour.

address.value: 70 Church Street, Nanaimo, British Columbia V9R 5H4
